abstract: Anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor (NMDA-R) encephalitis is an immune-mediated encephalitis that primarily affects young women. Due to the psychiatric and neurological symptoms, the diagnosis can be challenging, especially during pregnancy. During pregnancy, treatments must take into account the fetal and neonatal risk and the risk of premature delivery. We report a case of anti-NMDA encephalitis in a 31-years-old, 30 weeks pregnant women characterized by predominantly psychiatric symptoms, associated with ovarian teratoma. First-line treatments have led to an improvement in symptoms, allowing the pregnancy to be carried to term and a vaginal delivery.
abstract_ja: 抗N-メチル-D-アスパラギン酸受容体(NMDA-R)脳炎は主に若い女性に影響を与える免疫介在性脳炎です。精神症状および神経学的症状があるため、診断は特に妊娠中に困難です。妊娠中の治療は胎児および新生児リスクおよび早産のリスクを考慮する必要があります。31歳で妊娠30週の女性における卵巣奇形腫に関連した主に精神症状を特徴とする抗NMDA脳炎の症例を報告します。第一選択治療により症状の改善が得られ、妊娠を満期まで継続し、経腟分娩が可能になりました。
